content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Cost Optimization Initiative - European Operations Review
agenda_items: Analysis of procurement savings through centralized supplier negotiations
Assessment of R&D portfolio rationalization and resource reallocation
Review of manufacturing footprint consolidation across European sites
key_decisions: Approved market exit strategy for operations in three smaller European markets with consistent underperformance
Agreed to discontinue four late-stage development programs with limited commercial potential, reallocating €45M in R&D budget
Approved consolidation of manufacturing operations from five sites to three core facilities over 18 months
Endorsed implementation of European shared services center for finance, HR, and IT functions
Authorized procurement team to initiate centralized negotiations with top 20 API suppliers targeting 12-15% cost reduction
attendees: Paolo Conti, President European Commercial Operations
Dr. Elif Yılmaz, Chief Scientific Officer
Amara Okafor, VP Transformation & Operational Excellence
